model: Earth-reference terrestrial baseline; chosen to make physical and climate modelling internally consistent, not to assert that the fictional planet is identical to Earth.

mean_surface_gravity_m_s2.source: Consistent with Earth-reference mass and radius

total_surface_area_million_km2.source: Derived from spherical surface area; rounded

land_water_split_percent.status: Inherited working assumption; not approved as canon

mean_orbital_distance_AU.status: Reference orbit around a solar-mass star; provisional

climate_interpretation.note: Astronomical latitude bands are not climate classifications.

approximate_general_circulation_cells.hadley: roughly 0°–30° in each hemisphere, variable and seasonal
approximate_general_circulation_cells.ferrel: roughly 30°–60° in each hemisphere, variable and seasonal
approximate_general_circulation_cells.polar: roughly 60°–90° in each hemisphere, variable and seasonal

climate_interpretation.seasons: Opposite seasonal phases in the two hemispheres; seasonal intensity depends on axial tilt, orbital eccentricity, land-ocean distribution, atmosphere and ocean circulation.
climate_interpretation.unresolved: Atmospheric mass and composition, greenhouse gases, cloud behaviour, ocean heat transport, prevailing winds, rainfall and regional climates are not yet assigned.

limitations: All parameter values are a working Earth-reference proposal, not CANON.
The planet's exact atmosphere, hydrosphere chemistry, star type, moons and orbital architecture remain undecided.
The 30/70 land-water split remains a prior working assumption, not a confirmed fact.
The latitude overlay is drawn on a provisional linear SVG scaffold; no final cartographic projection is selected.
The tropics and polar circles are astronomical latitude limits derived from the proposed axial tilt, not biome or climate boundaries.
No regional temperatures, precipitation, ocean currents, wind belts, deserts, forests or ice coverage are assigned.
No plate geometry, plate boundaries or plate containment is changed.
